A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoLLM-CC/CoLLM-DC research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A-I. Text, equations, tables, and visually inspected figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original writing, coding, and Minecraft experiments in Figure 2 and Table 1, plus pass@k and training-overhead measurements in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including the learning curves, benchmark comparisons, and Appendix D measurements.

M1.justification: CoLLM-CC and CoLLM-DC retain the same architectures, actor/critic losses, history representation, teacher-forced probability calculations, and Algorithms 1-2. The Equation 1 correction does not establish a change to the proposed methods or their implementation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five tasks: TLDR summarization, arXiv expansion, CoopHE coding, StrBuild, and HouseBuild. No training or evaluation domain, dataset, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 retain the same single-model comparators, GRPO, AC, Parallel, Pipeline, Discussion, and MAGRPO alongside CoLLM-DC/CC. Table 3 also retains the same three-method training-overhead comparison.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendices C, E, and F retain the same splits, model configurations, training budgets, prompts, rewards, and evaluation metrics. Task horizons remain one turn for writing, two for coding, and four for Minecraft.

E4.justification: No ablation, sensitivity, robustness, or error-analysis evidence is added or removed. The illustrative Minecraft examples in Figure 3 and the training-overhead analysis in Appendix D.2 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages over five runs in Tables 1-3 and 95% bootstrapped confidence bands in Figure 2. Run-count, seed, and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-3 and the learning-curve data in Figure 2 are unchanged. For example, CoLLM-CC retains a 75.2% CoopHE pass rate and 68.5% StrBuild IoU in Table 1; no results or findings are added or removed.

T1.justification: Equation 1 in Section 4.1 adds a sum over t = 0 through H-1 to the MA-REINFORCE policy gradient, correcting the stated episode-level expression. The Dec-POMDP definitions, Propositions 4.1-4.3, and Appendix A proofs and assumptions are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about centralized critics, sample efficiency, and performance on long-horizon or sparse-reward tasks. No headline claim is strengthened, narrowed, or added.

C2.justification: The explanations involving Monte Carlo variance and decentralized-critic non-stationarity are unchanged. Appendix I retains the same limitations concerning proof-of-concept experiments, longer horizons, larger agent populations, parameter sharing, and execution without communication.

D1.justification: The abstract and Appendix H update release references from v1.3.2 to v1.3.6 for the same code and experiment repositories. Section 8 newly credits the Explorer Cluster. Detailed implementation settings remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish what changed inside the referenced releases.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to earlier LLM collaboration and actor-critic research are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds an ICML proceedings/copyright notice and revises computing acknowledgments, including attribution of Lambda support to Shuo Liu. The main narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 4 replace vector artwork with raster versions of the same diagrams, with altered spacing and proportions in Figure 4 and reduced sharpness when enlarged. Figure 2 is resized and nearby text reflows; its data, captions, and the tables remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Adding the missing time summation in Equation 1 improves mathematical precision and consistency with the episode objective and actor-critic gradients. This is a limited gain: empirical evidence, proofs, and conclusions remain unchanged, while Figures 1 and 4 lose sharpness after rasterization but remain legible.
